introduction: The following special conditions apply to this project and supplement the General Terms & Conditions. Please read carefully before accepting.

terms.title: Payment Schedule
terms.content: Payment to be made in four stages: 25% upon instruction, 25% upon planning submission, 25% upon Building Regulations approval, and 25% upon completion of construction drawings. Each stage payment must be received before work on the next stage commences.

terms.title: Party Wall Agreement
terms.content: The client acknowledges that a Party Wall Agreement with the neighbouring property at 44 Meadow Lane may be required. Noble Architecture will provide technical drawings to support this process, but the client is responsible for appointing and paying for a Party Wall Surveyor if required. This is not included in the quoted fees.

terms.title: Planning Conditions
terms.content: If planning permission is granted subject to conditions, any additional work required to discharge these conditions (such as landscaping plans, materials schedules, or sustainability statements) will be charged at our standard hourly rate of £85/hour plus VAT.

terms.title: Construction Timeline
terms.content: Site inspection visits during construction are scheduled at key stages. Additional site visits requested by the client or required due to contractor issues will be charged at £180 per visit plus VAT and travel costs.

terms.title: Project Duration
terms.content: This quotation is valid for 60 days from the date shown above. The estimated timeline from instruction to completion of all architectural services is 6-8 months, subject to planning authority timescales and client approval at key stages.
